name: Negotiation
definition: Decision making on the transfer of a financial instrument.

TradingMethod.name: Trading Method
TradingMethod.definition: Method used by the trading parties to negotiate and/or execute a deal.

TradeExecution.name: Trade Execution
TradeExecution.definition: Execution of a trade as a result of a successful negotiation between two trading parties.

TradingSystem.name: Trading System
TradingSystem.definition: Electronic system through which parties are able to negotiate trades.

Quote.name: Quote
Quote.definition: Quote details shown in a negotiation process.

IndicationOfInterest.name: Indication Of Interest
IndicationOfInterest.definition: Indication of interest process which is the start of the negotiation.
